slice: Natural conversation round 4: intro, joke, and memory-recall handlers

my name is alice.reply: Alice — nice to put a name to you. I'll remember that.
my name is alice.reason: You told me your name, so I acknowledged it and said I'd remember it.

tell me a joke.reply: Why did the robot break up with the toaster? Too many sparks, not enough chemistry.
tell me a joke.reason: You asked for a joke, so I gave you a light, in-character one.

what do you remember about alice?.reply: What I've got on alice: I learned you like jazz.
what do you remember about alice?.reason: You asked what I remember, so I told you what I actually know (or said honestly I don't know you yet)

what system?.reply: Sorry — I think I got a bit ahead of myself. What would you like me to clear up?
what system?.reason: You asked me to clarify or repeat something, so I acknowledged and re-engaged rather than guessing

before.my name is alice: I don't have a good answer on alice yet — what's it like from your side?
before.tell me a joke: I don't have a good answer on joke yet — what's it like from your side?
before.what do you remember about me?: I don't have a good answer on remember yet — what's it like from your side?

mechanism: introductions acknowledged by name; joke requests get a light in-character quip; memory-recall questions answered honestly with learned facts (or an honest 'not much yet')
